## Summary
Briefly describe what shipped.

## Why
What launch goal or user outcome this supports.

## Changes
- Key implementation changes.
- Notable non-goals or out-of-scope items.

## How to test
1. Steps to validate locally/staging.
2. Expected result.

## Security
- Auth/data/secrets impact.
- New dependencies, permissions, or external calls.

## Risk
- Risk level (Low/Medium/High) and likely failure modes.
- Rollback or mitigation plan.

## Checklist

- [ ] Manual validation completed
- [ ] Security impact reviewed
- [ ] Observability/alerts considered
- [ ] Rollback path confirmed
